meta.name: Pixelole Overworld Tileset
meta.description: Free sample tileset (Pixelole's overword Tileset1.0 free.zip), unzipped from the repo root. Not wired into any game yet.

atlases.note: Overworld terrain blocks (grass, water, cliff) plus separate object sprites (trees, rocks, a small house, bridges, a signpost) packed into one sheet. Terrain blocks look grid-aligned on inspection but an exact tile size could not be verified without the original source/README, so no frameWidth/frameHeight is asserted here - confirm visually or against the pack's own docs before treating this as a fixed-cell spritesheet.

usage: Load with this.load.image('pixelole-overworld-master', basePath + 'MasterSimple.png') and slice regions manually once tile boundaries are confirmed, or repack with a texture-packer tool.
